title: NovaCorp Employee Data Privacy & GDPR Policy
content:
NovaCorp Employee Data Privacy Policy — GDPR Compliant — January 2025

1. DATA WE COLLECT
NovaCorp collects the following categories of employee data: identification information (name, date of birth, national ID), contact information, employment and compensation details, performance records, payroll and tax information, benefits enrollment, access logs, and communication records where permitted by law.

2. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING
Employee data is processed on the following legal bases: contractual necessity (employment contract), legal obligation (tax and labor law compliance), legitimate interests (business operations and security), and consent (where explicitly requested).

3. DATA RETENTION
Employment records are retained for 7 years after separation. Payroll records are retained for 10 years per tax law requirements. Performance reviews are retained for 5 years. Access logs are retained for 2 years. Data subject to legal hold is retained until the hold is lifted.

4. EMPLOYEE RIGHTS
Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, employees have the right to: access their personal data, request correction of inaccurate data, object to processing in certain circumstances, and request deletion of data not subject to legal retention requirements. Rights requests should be submitted to privacy@novacorp.com.

5. DATA SECURITY
Employee data is stored in encrypted systems with access restricted on a need-to-know basis. All HR systems require multi-factor authentication. Data is not sold to third parties. Third-party HR vendors are subject to Data Processing Agreements.

6. CROSS-BORDER TRANSFERS
Employee data may be transferred to NovaCorp entities in the US, EU, and APAC regions. All transfers comply with GDPR Chapter V requirements through Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions.

7. CONTACT
Questions about this policy should be directed to the Data Protection Officer at dpo@novacorp.com or the HR department.
